100 D (1 B 4) A 2 B (13 A 11) C 3 B (17 C 12)

By using BODMAS RULE :

Given equation is : 100 D (1 B 4) A 2 B (13 A 11) C 3 B (17 C 12)

By inserting the given symbols the equation formed is as follows : 

100 ÷ (1 × 4) + 2 × (13 + 11) - 3 × (17 - 12)

= 100 ÷ (__**1 × 4**__) + 2 × (__**13 + 11**__) - 3 × (__**17 - 12**__)

= __**100 ÷ 4**__ + 2 × 24 - 3 × 5

= 25 + __**2 × 24**__ - __**3 × 5**__

= **__73 - 15__**

= 58

Hence, the correct answer is **"58".**

questions.question: If the diagonal of a square is increased by 4 cm, its area increases by 56 cm² . Find the ratio of the new area of the square to the initial area of the square.
questions.solution:
Area of Square (A₁) = S² ................... (1)

Length of diagonal (d₁) = sqrt{2} S .............. (2)

From eq(2) → S = d₁/sqrt{2}

Area of square (A₁) = (d₁/sqrt{2})²

A₁ = (d₁)²/2 ........... (3)

∴ The diagonal of the square increased by 4cm and its area increased by 56cm².

Increased diagonal of square (d₂) = d₁ + 4 ........... (4)

Increased area of square (A₂) = A₁ + 56 .......... (5)

A₂ = (d₂)²/2

From eq (3) we get, 

A₂ = (d₁ + 4)²/2 .......... (6)

From eq (4) we get,

A₂ - A₁ = 56 .......... (7)

Substitute eq (3) and eq (6) in eq (7)

⇒ (d1 + 4)2/2 - (d1)2/2 = 56

⇒ (d₁ + 4)² - (d1)2 = 56 × 2

⇒ (d1 + 4)2 - (d1)2 = 112

⇒ (d₁)² + 8d₁ + 16 - (d1)2 = 112

⇒ 8d1 + 16 = 112

⇒ 8d1 = 112 - 16

⇒ 8d1 = 96

⇒ d₁ = 12

∴ d₂ = d₁ + 4

d₂ = 12 + 4 = 16

Ratio of the new area of the square to the initial area of the square = A₂ / A₁

A₂ / A₁ = ((d2)2/2) / ((d1)2/2 )

A2 / A₁ = (16² / 2) / (12² / 2)

A2 / A₁ = (256 / 2) / (144 / 2)

A2 / A₁ = 128 / 72

A2 / A₁ = 16 / 9

∴ Here, the Ratio of the new area of the square to the initial area of the square **A₂ : A₁** **= 16 : 9**

Hence, the correct answer is **"16 : 9".**

questions.question: The money value of all the final goods and services produced within the country during a particular year is called _________.

__
 
• The money value of all the final goods and services produced within the country during a particular year is called Gross Domestic Product.

• Real GDP adjusts for price changes due to inflation/deflation.
 
• The main difference between nominal GDP and real GDP is the adjustment for inflation.

• **The National Income** of any country means the complete value of the goods and services produced by any country during its financial year.

questions.question: If the compound interest on a certain sum of money for two years at 9% p.a. is Rs. 3,762, then the sum is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Compound Interest rate for 2 years = R + R + (R × R) ÷ 100.

Effective rate for 9% = 9 + 9 + (81 ÷ 100) = 18.81%.

Let the principal sum be P.

⇒ 18.81% of P = 3762

⇒ P = 3762 × (100 ÷ 18.81) = 20000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 20,000.**

**Given:**

Rate of interest (R) = 9% p.a.

Time (n) = 2 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1eb8888856736926e9059c29f7ea64361c5a0fe08459ff97a1d293c3a563fa77.png] 

**Formula Used:**

CI = P × [(1 + R ÷ 100)ⁿ − 1]

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3762 = P × [(1 + 9 ÷ 100)² − 1]

⇒ 3762 = P × [(109 ÷ 100)² − 1]

⇒ 3762 = P × [11881 ÷ 10000 − 1]

⇒ 3762 = P × [(11881 − 10000) ÷ 10000]

⇒ 3762 = P × [1881 ÷ 10000]

⇒ P = (3762 × 10000) ÷ 1881

⇒ P = 2 × 10000 = 20000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 20,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Compound Interest

For 2 years at R% per annum, the effective compound interest rate is calculated using the formula: R + R + (R² ÷ 100)%. This helps in quickly calculating the CI without deriving the total amount first.

Difference Between CI and SI for 2 Years

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on a principal P at rate R% for exactly 2 years is given directly by the formula: Difference = P × (R ÷ 100)².

Amount in Compound Interest

The total amount A after n years at compound interest is calculated using A = P(1 + R ÷ 100)ⁿ. The interest is then simply found by subtracting the original principal from the final amount.

Given: 

A and B can complete a work in 120 days. 

B and C can complete it in 150 days.

A and C can complete it in 200 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Work done per day × Total time taken 

Calculation:

LCM (120, 150, 200) = 600 units

Let, Total work = LCM of the time taken by different workers

The efficiencies of A, B, and C be denoted by a, b, and c.

So, Total work = 600 units

Let the efficiencies of A, B, and C be denoted by A, B, and C.

According to the question,

a + b = 600/120

⇒ a + b = 5 ---(1)

b + c = 600/150

⇒ b + c = 4 ---(2)

a + c = 600/200

⇒ a + c = 3 ---(3)

Equation (1) + Equation (2) + Equation (3),

⇒ a + b + b + c + a + c = 5 + 4 + 3

⇒ 2(a + b + c) = 12

⇒ (a + b + c) = 12/2

⇒ (a + b + c) = 6 ---(4)

Subtracting equation (4) from equation (3),

(a + b + c) - (a + c) = 6 - 3

⇒ a + b + c - a - c = 3

⇒ b = 3
